notes: Pacific County's two District Court seats are elected by electoral district (North: the Willapa Harbor precincts; South: the Long Beach peninsula, Ilwaco, Chinook, Naselle and Nemah precincts) and are scoped DISTCRT 'North' and 'South'. No public GIS layer for these districts was found; until one is added the seats cannot be matched to an address.
Pacific County PUD No. 2 and Timberland Regional Library District each cover all of Pacific County (WA DOR PUD2025 and LIB2025 each have one Pacific polygon with the county's area).
The EMS measure is scoped EMSDST '1' (WA DOR EMS2025, layer 6) and the fire measures FIRDST '3' and '6' (WA DOR FIR2025, layer 7), DISTATTRIB.
Unresolvable district scopes (no queryable official boundary): DISTCRT. Contests/measures scoped to them are hidden rather than shown to the wrong voters.

measures.title: Regular Property Tax Levy Lid Lift for Library Services, Operations and Maintenance
measures.what_it_does: Restores the Timberland Regional Library District's regular property tax levy from about $0.22 to $0.35 per $1,000 of assessed value for 2027 and 2028; the 2028 levy amount becomes the base for later limits (chapter 84.55 RCW).
measures.cost_line: From $0.228924 to $0.35 per $1,000 of assessed value in 2027 and 2028; about $40.44 a year on a $334,000 home, per the explanatory statement.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.jurisdiction: North Pacific County Emergency Medical Services District No. 1
measures.title: Ambulance and Emergency Medical Services Funding
measures.what_it_does: Renews the EMS district's one-year excess levy for 2027 to subsidize ambulance and emergency medical service in the Naselle, Nemah, Bay Center, South Bend, Raymond and Willapa Valley areas (Resolution 2026-721). Needs 60% approval.
measures.cost_line: $0.40 per $1,000 of assessed value, no more than $800,000, collected in 2027 only.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.jurisdiction: Pacific County Fire Protection District No. 3
measures.title: Property Tax Levy Lid Lift for Fire Protection, Suppression and Prevention
measures.what_it_does: Raises Fire District 3's regular property tax levy to up to $0.61 per $1,000 for collection in 2027 (Resolution 26-2503-01); that levy becomes the base for later limits. The district serves Menlo, Lebam, Frances, Baleville, Elk Horn Flats, Old Willapa and East Raymond.
measures.cost_line: Up to $0.61 per $1,000 of assessed value in 2027, a $0.20 increase per the explanatory statement.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.jurisdiction: Pacific County Fire Protection District No. 6
measures.title: Authorizing Regular Property Tax Levy
measures.what_it_does: Restores Fire District 6's regular property tax levy to $0.50 per $1,000 for collection in 2027 and lets it grow up to 6% a year (capped at $1.50 per $1,000) for the next five years (Resolution 2026-7-23-1); the 2031 levy becomes the base for later limits.
measures.cost_line: $0.50 per $1,000 of assessed value in 2027, then up to 6% more levy revenue a year through 2032 collection.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.
